summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry and Control.title(title), which passes one two-item code. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) once per title control. CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only). Nothing was run or committed, per instructions; verification was by reading the code only.
